title: IDPC Decision 2025: The complainant alleged:that the controller failed to provide a complete respons
text:
Type: Data Protection Complaint

Description: The complainant alleged:that the controller failed to provide a complete response to her access request made in 2019;•	that the complainant made a more recent access request in 2025, and the controller’s response thereto was not complete and omitted key categories of personal data

Outcome: Firstly, the Commissioner decided that to ensure procedural fairness and safeguard the integrity of the investigation, the scope of the investigation could not extend to the complainant’s allegation regarding her 2019 access request, given the nearly six-year delay between the events complained of and the lodging of her complaint.Regarding the complainant’s 2025 access request, after the controller disclosed further requested personal data to the complainant, the Commissioner concluded that he was satisfied that no additional personal data was in the controller’s possession beyond what was already disclosed.

Corrective Action: The Commissioner advised the controller to undertake a review of its existing record-keeping systems and processes, in order to ensure more efficient and complete responses to data subject requests in future.
